title: Rhythm choices with complete motif returns
playback_note: Untouched seed-608 generated original; the earlier 56/87-attack learned-window versions are retained exactly as PREVIOUS-MODEL comparisons. The 89/88-attack coupled-motif versions are now verified against the corrected clean-window model. The correction excludes every measure touched by a note held across a barline, including continuation measures. It uses the same frozen source tracks, features, strengths and data splits; this is a correctness recheck on an already exposed holdout, not new blind validation. Both coupled selections have exactly unchanged notes, timing, contacts, marks and audio. Source-fitted density and return factors change candidate probabilities, but the same fixed draw still selects the same candidate as factors off in BOTH versions, so causal selection improvement is not demonstrated. Each coupled version shares its complete generated opening across four sections and returns its full first motif in section three. Motif constraints and intentions remain authored, not learned phrase function or taste. Same melodic scaffold, 150 BPM, GM guitar and gain. Colors use exact source occurrence first, otherwise nearest; extra repetitions get distinct identities. Full eight-bar phrase shown; listening acceptance and new corpus noncopy remain unproved.
questions: Compared with the earlier versions, do the new coupled versions make the opening and its return easier to recognize?
Which new version makes the contrasting second and fourth sections feel more connected to the opening?
Which gaps, held notes or repeated attacks help the riff, and which feel awkward?

versions.label: Learned windows: space intention
versions.description: A new full rhythm with learned window priors for activity, rests, repetition and contrast. Initial rhythm and melody-mapping policies are authored; space is an intention, not measured superiority. Measured against untouched original: 56 attacks (100 before), 64 notes (108 before); 56 mapped onsets, 39 holds, 17 contacts and 0 accents differ.

versions.label: Learned windows: connected intention
versions.description: A new full rhythm with the same melodic scaffold and a connected-motion intention. Phrase functions and musical recognizability remain listening questions; this is not a learned full-form claim. Measured against untouched original: 87 attacks (100 before), 95 notes (108 before); 79 mapped onsets, 42 holds, 17 contacts and 0 accents differ.

versions.label: Coupled motif: space (89 attacks)
versions.description: A complete new rhythm with the same generated melodic-rhythmic opening in all four sections and an exact full first-motif return in section three. Space and bursts is the authored intention. Source-fitted density and return factors change selection probabilities, but select the same candidate as factors off in this frozen pool. Rechecked with the corrected clean-window model using unchanged frozen features and splits; this selected musical output is exactly unchanged, so verified audio is reused. Measured against untouched original: 89 attacks (100 before), 97 notes (108 before); 91 mapped onsets, 52 holds, 17 contacts and 0 accents differ.
